method: Conservative verse-specific topical triage from Qur'anic content. No primary pre-Islamic passage or critical edition checked in this session; not a comprehensive comparative review. No source relationship asserted or public publication authorized.

records.topic: Whether punishment is witnessed in the prophet's lifetime or afterward
records.assessment: The verse contrasts punishment seen during the messenger's life with God's ultimate return and witness; do not confuse with historical accounts of particular battles. Examine prophetic judgment oracles only after precise text checks.

records.topic: A messenger for every community and judgment in justice
records.assessment: General messenger-to-nations and impartial judgment themes. The two clauses must be evaluated together before claiming any specific biblical or late-antique literary parallel.

records.topic: Demand to know when the promised judgment will occur
records.assessment: Challenge about the timing of a promised warning. Potential prophetic-delay motif is widespread; no specific source text has been inspected for a distinctive parallel.

records.topic: Messenger cannot control harm or benefit; every community has an appointed term
records.assessment: Distinguish messenger's inability to determine harm or benefit from the appointed communal term. A generic divine-sovereignty parallel is insufficient for a verified source card.

records.topic: Sudden divine punishment by night or day
records.assessment: Temporal surprise and warning of divine punishment; inspect narrative and prophetic traditions for precise verbal or situational correspondences before staging any candidate.
